title: Utsang 2K26
venue: SRiX Auditorium, SR University Campus, Warangal, Telangana, India
theme: AI-Driven Innovation in Sustainable and Resilient Emerging Technologies
summary: Warangal zonal congress hosted by IEEE Student Branch, SR University, connecting students, researchers, academicians, industry experts, and IEEE leaders.
description: UTSANG 2026 - IEEE Warangal Zonal Student Congress was held on 11 April 2026 at the SRiX Auditorium, SR University Campus, Warangal. Hosted by the IEEE Student Branch of SR University (Branch Code: STB63811) in collaboration with the IEEE Hyderabad Section Student Activities Committee (SAC), the congress ran from 10:00 AM to 4:30 PM with 120 verified participants. Built around the theme of AI-driven innovation in sustainable and resilient emerging technologies, the programme combined inaugural proceedings, IEEE leadership addresses, technical sessions spanning smart grids, materials and nanotechnology, AI, and enterprise software, along with interactive Q&A, a panel discussion, and formal recognition of organizers, volunteers, and participants.
outcomes: 120 verified participants from the Warangal zone and broader Hyderabad Section
Cross-branch interaction among students, faculty, IEEE leaders, researchers, and industry professionals
Technical exposure spanning smart grids and sustainable energy systems, materials and nanotechnology, AI, and enterprise software
Leadership and professional-development engagement for student delegates
Interactive Q&A sessions and panel discussion with subject-matter experts
Networking among participants from the Warangal zone and the broader Hyderabad Section
Recognition of organizers, volunteers, and participants
